text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi official press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraqi athletes leave Lebanese-Syrian borders on their way back home.
- Arab MPs, figures and newspapers condemn Lebanon's decision denying visas to Iraqi athletes.
- The International Committee of the Red Cross expresses concern over the deteriorating health situation in Iraq.
- A U.N. report admits the embargo on Iraq undermines economic growth in western Asian countries.

- President Saddam Hussein gave orders that Tuesday July 15, 1997 is a public holiday in Iraq because it comes between two holidays -- the July 14 revolution anniversary on Monday and Prophet Mohammad birthday anniversary on Wednesday.
(The above were carried by THAWRA and QADISSIYA)
- Commentary condemning the Lebanses government for not allowing Iraqi athletes from taking part in the Pan Arab Games.
